# Welcome Greeter

> Sends a one-time welcome message to new contacts on their first message — with contact name
> personalization and optional re-greet after a configurable cooldown. Designed to coexist with
> other plugins.

## Features

- **One-shot welcome** — sends a welcome message the first time a contact messages you, then stays out
  of the way forever (or for N days). Never repeats.
- **Minimal permissions** — only `messages:send`. No outbound HTTP, no engine reads.
- **Plays well with others** — returns `{ continue: true }` so FAQ Bot, Chat Flow, Typebot, and any
  other plugin still processes the message. Your welcome message is just the handshake; the real
  conversation follows.
- **Contact name templating** — use `{{contactName}}` (resolves to the sender's name or push name) and
  `{{chatId}}` (their WhatsApp JID) in your welcome text.
- **Group support** — optionally greet in group chats (scoped to the sender, not the group).
- **Re-greet after N days** — if a contact hasn't messaged in N days, send the welcome again as if new.
  `0` = greet only once, ever.
- **Fail-fast config** — a missing welcome text shows as `ERROR` in the dashboard rather than silently
  sending nothing.

## How it works

```
Contact messages → hook:message:received
  ↓
Has this chat been greeted before (ctx.storage)?
  ├─ Yes, within resetAfterDays → skip (return {continue: true})
  ├─ Yes, but resetAfterDays passed → re-greet
  └─ No → send welcome, mark greeted
  ↓
Return {continue: true} ← other plugins still fire
```

## Install

```bash
node package.mjs welcome-greeter    # produces welcome-greeter.zip at the repo root

curl -X POST "https://your-openwa-host/plugins/install" \
  -H "X-API-Key: <ADMIN_API_KEY>" -F "file=@welcome-greeter.zip"

curl -X PUT "https://your-openwa-host/plugins/welcome-greeter/config" \
  -H "X-API-Key: <ADMIN_API_KEY>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "config": { "welcomeText": "Hey {{contactName}}! 👋 Thanks for reaching out — how can we help?" } }'

curl -X POST "https://your-openwa-host/plugins/welcome-greeter/enable" \
  -H "X-API-Key: <ADMIN_API_KEY>"
```

Or download the packaged `.zip` from [Releases](https://github.com/rmyndharis/OpenWA-plugins/releases)
and upload it in the dashboard **Plugins → Install** (or the **Catalog** tab).

## Configuration

| Key | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | -------- | ------- | ----------- |
| `welcomeText` | yes | — | Message sent to a new contact. Use `{{contactName}}` (name/pushName) and `{{chatId}}` (JID). |
| `greetInGroups` | no | `false` | Whether to also send the welcome in group chats. |
| `resetAfterDays` | no | `0` | Re-greet after N days of inactivity. `0` = once ever. |

## Templates

| Variable | Resolves to |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `{{contactName}}` | The sender's name, pushName, or phone number. Falls back to "there". |
| `{{chatId}}` | The WhatsApp JID of the chat (e.g. `123456789@c.us`). |

### Examples

```text
Hey {{contactName}}! 👋 Welcome to Acme Corp! Type "help" to see what I can do.

Bonjour {{contactName}} ! Merci de nous avoir contactés — un agent vous répondra sous peu.

¡Hola {{contactName}}! Bienvenido/a. ¿En qué podemos ayudarte?
```

## Compatibility

Targets OpenWA **≥ 0.6.1** (sandboxed runtime with `ctx.storage`, `messages:send`, `onConfigChange`).
